root_cause: _arithmetic_mask checks whether operand is None but not whether operand.mask is None when the left operand has a mask. A maskless operand therefore reaches handle_mask(self.mask, None), causing np.bitwise_or to fail. Scalar operands also take this path because they are wrapped as NDData-like objects.

FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS defaults to None, so FileSystemStorage skips its final chmod. Streamed memory uploads are created with 0o666 masked by umask, while temporary uploads are moved by rename or metadata-preserving copy, retaining their temporary-file permissions. Consequently, upload paths can produce different final permissions.
